headline: Weathered Expanse Turns; Ruin Spreads on Fisherman's Row
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has tipped further toward the Colonials, the count now reading seven posts to one Warden with another in ruin, while Frostmarch, Crow's Nest, and Wightwalk remain the busiest ground and two-hour losses run past six hundred a side. Fisherman's Row, swept of Warden flags in our previous report, has seen three of its own posts laid waste, the ledger now six standing against three in no-man's-land. The Stlican Shelf steadies at six Colonial, two Warden, one wrecked, with Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost still drawing fire, fifty-seven base events logged there in a day. Callahan's Passage endures as the war's deadliest field, all ten Warden holdings intact yet daily losses past twelve thousand a side, The Latch again the busiest point. Mooring County still flickers about The Wind Hills; the Nevish Line, whose posts last stirred late yesterday, has gone still, as have the Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow, though Viper Pit bleeds without a flag moving. It is day 425; thirty-four victory towns decide the war, and no victor is named.
